summary: Patch correctly makes BoundWidget.id_for_label honor the id from ChoiceWidget.options (self.data['attrs']['id']) while keeping the old format string as fallback, matching Django's accepted fix for the ticket. Change is minimal and backward-compatible.

issues.description: Diff shows a no-op edit to choice_label (identical old/new line, likely trailing-whitespace change) unrelated to the fix; harmless but slightly widens scope.
